files.description: Bike-share riders, one per row (400 rows): rider_id (six-digit id with leading zeros), display_name (person name, some with accented letters), home_district (one of 6 districts such as "Old Town"), membership (casual, monthly or annual) - these three text columns have inconsistent capital letters and stray spaces; joined_on (date as text, YYYY-MM-DD; about 2% empty), birth_year (whole number; about 4% empty), credit_balance (two decimals, can be negative; about 5% empty).

task_text: Going down riders.csv in file order, compute for each rider the bitwise AND of its birth_year and the birth_year of the rider just above it (a rolling window of two values). The first rider, and every rider where either of the two birth_year values is empty, gets an empty value. `result` should hold one value per rider, in file order.
intended_computation: Read riders.csv; b = birth_year in file order; value[i] = b[i] & b[i-1] (bitwise AND of the two whole numbers), missing for i = 0 or when either value is empty; 400 values in file order.

acceptable_variants.notes: values may be float, nullable integers or a list; missing may be NaN/None/NA

intent_summary: Over a column of whole numbers, compute the bitwise AND inside a rolling window of two consecutive values.
